# Finding Peace in God's Presence

## Matthew 11:28-30 (NIV)

"Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light."

## Reflection

In a world filled with chaos and uncertainty, we often find ourselves feeling weary and burdened. We try to carry the weight of our problems on our own shoulders, but it only leads to exhaustion and frustration. Jesus invites us to come to him, to lay down our burdens and take on his yoke instead. His yoke is not a heavy load, but a gentle guidance that leads us to rest and peace. As we learn from him, we discover that his way is not a burden, but a source of strength and comfort. We are not alone in our struggles; Jesus is present with us, offering his rest and his peace.

## Prayer

We confess that we often try to carry our burdens alone, but we thank you for offering us your rest and peace, Lord. Help us to come to you and take on your yoke, that we may find true rest for our souls. Guide us in your gentle and humble heart.

## One-Line Application

We must come to Jesus, laying down our burdens, to find true rest and peace.
